# Pages written by the original PaperBack

These pages were written by the real PaperBack 1.00 (`v100`) and 1.10 (`v110`) programs and are
decoded by `tests/original_pages.rs`, so the tests prove compatibility without needing the
original executables.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `text-1.bmp` | `sample.txt`: 400 lines of "Lorem ipsum paper test line", bzip2, one page, as the original wrote it (BMP) |
| `pattern-1.png`, `pattern-2.png` | `pattern.bin`: 120000 generated bytes, uncompressed, two pages |
| `text-crypt-1.png` | `sample.txt` encrypted with the password `correct horse` |
| `text-umlaut-1.png` | `sample.txt` encrypted with the password `pässwört` (non-ASCII, Windows-1252 bytes) |

Every file has the modification time 2024-01-02 03:04:05 UTC and a generic name; the pages hold no
other information (no paths, user names or machine data). Pages other than the first case were
converted from the original BMP to PNG without loss to save space.

Regenerate on Windows with `tools/interop/make-fixtures.ps1` (it drives the original programs
through their file dialogs; it never prints or scans).
